### Borea v0.7.0

Update with "Update now" on the Home banner or run `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Added

- Screenshots in the Library: as soon as you have screenshots, the Library gets a Screenshots tab with the screenshots of all your instances and of the game profile in one place, newest first. Filter by instance, click a picture to open it, or use its menu to show it in its folder or copy its path. Thank you, @Kiwi-Shark, for the idea!
- The Game data tab of an instance shows its six newest screenshots, and "Show all" opens them in the Library.
- When a game of an instance ends, a toast tells you how many new screenshots it saved and opens them.
- The share dialog offers the screenshots of the instance as pictures, and the picture picker opens in the screenshots folder.

#### Improved

- The Game data tab names its rows: Game settings, HUD layouts, Crash dumps, Screenshots and Other exports. The Screenshots row shows how many pictures the instance has and their size.
- The menu of an instance has "Open screenshots folder".
- The delete dialog says how many screenshots an instance has and keeps them by default. Borea copies them to `Pictures/Kitten Space Agency/<instance name>` before it deletes the instance. If the copy fails, the instance stays.
- A share picture above 10 MB is no longer refused. Borea saves it again as a JPEG, and makes it smaller only when that is not enough, so a 4K screenshot can be shared.

[Full changelog for v0.6.29 to v0.7.0](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.29...v0.7.0)
